# ensure siblings list
if 'phone_access_token' not in globals() or not phone_access_token:
    raise RuntimeError('phone_access_token missing')

page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_access_token, relationship='sibling', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    siblings.extend(page)
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1
print('siblings_count', len(siblings))

# ensure amazon token
if 'amazon_access_token' not in globals() or not amazon_access_token:
    amazon_password = None
    for item in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords():
        if item['account_name']=='amazon':
            amazon_password = item['password']
    amazon_login_res = apis.amazon.login(username='erikabail@gmail.com', password=amazon_password)
    amazon_access_token = amazon_login_res.get('access_token')

print('amazon_token_len', len(amazon_access_token) if amazon_access_token else None)

# Search all products of type 'hiking boots' in price range 80-130, sorted by -rating
best = None
best_candidates = []
max_rating = -1
max_reviews = -1

page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    res = apis.amazon.search_products(
        product_type='hiking boots',
        query='',
        min_price=80,
        max_price=130,
        sort_by='-rating',
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=page_limit
    )
    if not res:
        break
    # collect
    for p in res:
        rating = p.get('rating', 0.0)
        price = p.get('price', None)
        num_reviews = p.get('num_product_reviews', 0)
        if price is None:
            continue
        # guard price range
        if not (80 <= price <= 130):
            continue
        if rating > max_rating:
            max_rating = rating
            max_reviews = num_reviews
            best_candidates = [p]
        elif rating == max_rating:
            if num_reviews > max_reviews:
                max_reviews = num_reviews
                best_candidates = [p]
            elif num_reviews == max_reviews:
                best_candidates.append(p)
    print('page', page_index, 'got', len(res), 'current_max_rating', max_rating, 'candidate_count', len(best_candidates))
    if len(res) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

print('overall_max_rating', max_rating)
print('overall_best_candidates_count', len(best_candidates))
# pick deterministic: first candidate in list
best = best_candidates[0] if best_candidates else None
print('selected_product_id', best.get('product_id') if best else None)
print('selected_name', best.get('name') if best else None)
print('selected_price', best.get('price') if best else None)
print('selected_num_reviews', best.get('num_product_reviews') if best else None)
print('selected_delivery_days', best.get('delivery_days') if best else None)
print('best_candidates_sample_ids', [c.get('product_id') for c in best_candidates[:10]])
